title: Airy Aromatic Ethiopian Chicken Kik Alisha
description: A light and nutty Ethiopian dish featuring yuzu-kosho and candy, this paleo-friendly kik alicha is a unique twist on traditional Ethiopian cuisine. The combination of flavors and textures creates a glassy-jelly like consistency.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine yuzu kosho, onion, garlic, and ginger, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blended mixture and chicken broth.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and bake in the oven for 25 minutes.
While the chicken is baking, melt the coconut oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the candy to the saucepan and stir until melted and smooth.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve the chicken with the melted candy sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
